encoding_rule.r16: R16: every CarryProjectionV1 union is internally tagged by kind; discharged.by is independently kind-tagged; unknown kind literals classify as d5_carry_proof_mismatch.
encoding_rule.served_digest: R16/contract clause 2a: SHA-256(U32BE tag length || ASCII mc.d5.block.served.v1 || U32BE(1) || CE1(bytes)); CE1 bytes is U64BE length followed by exact UTF-8 source_text bytes.
encoding_rule.expectations: Every vector expected outcome and every precedence-row outcome is owner-authored fixture data; the Rust oracle only compares them.
encoding_rule.unit_validation: R17.2 step 0 validates each UnitRecordV1 from served_array locator bytes (none means empty), then validates the coverage-bearing aggregate before reading coverage_proof.

precondition_space.independence_rule: Dimension value lists are owner-authored independently of precedence rows. Step 0 unit validation precedes proof evaluation. A row may collapse a complete dimension only by naming it in applies_regardless_of.
